mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, NULLIF(TRIM(p.code), '') AS object_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.task_code), '') AS task_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.workshop_code), '') AS workshop_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.route_code), '') AS route_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.source_route_node_code), '') AS route_node_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.mat_code), '') AS mat_code, p.status, p.notice_date AS notice_time, p.start_time, p.finish_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mom_mes.mes_produce_task d WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(d.code), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(p.code), '') AND d.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND d.factory_code = #{factory} AND d.del_flag = '0') AS code_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mom_mes.mes_task t WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(t.code), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(p.task_code), '') AND t.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND t.factory_code = #{factory} AND t.del_flag = '0') AS parent_count FROM mom_mes.mes_produce_task p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND p.factory_code = #{factory} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status NOT IN ('FINISH', 'CLOSE')) AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.task_code), '') = #{q.taskCode} AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.route_code), '') = #{q.routeCode}

SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN object_code IS NULL OR code_count != 1 THEN 'MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_OBJECT_CODE' WHEN task_code IS NULL OR parent_count != 1 THEN 'MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_PARENT' WHEN route_code IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_ROUTE_CODE' ELSE NULL END AS source_issue FROM () b

WHEN source_issue IS NOT NULL THEN source_issue WHEN status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('WAIT', 'UN_RECEIVE', 'RECEIVE', 'PRODUCT', 'PAUSE') THEN 'UNKNOWN_STATUS' WHEN finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONTRADICTORY_FINISH_TIME' WHEN start_time > #{observed} THEN 'FUTURE_START_TIME'

SELECT s.*, CASE
WHEN notice_time IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_NOTICE_TIME' WHEN notice_time > #{observed} THEN 'FUTURE_NOTICE_TIME' WHEN notice_time > start_time THEN 'INVERTED_NOTICE_START' ELSE NULL END AS queue_issue, CASE
WHEN notice_time > start_time THEN 'INVERTED_NOTICE_START' WHEN start_time IS NULL AND status IN ('PRODUCT', 'PAUSE') THEN 'MISSING_START_TIME' ELSE NULL END AS start_issue FROM () s

SELECT e.*, CASE WHEN queue_issue IS NOT NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN notice_time < #{cutoff} THEN 'OVER' ELSE 'WITHIN' END AS aging_category FROM () e
workshop_code = #{q.workshopCode}

CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS population_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS waiting_dispatch_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'UN_RECEIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS waiting_receive_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RECEIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS received_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PRODUCT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS producing_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAUSE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS paused_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('WAIT', 'UN_RECEIVE', 'RECEIVE', 'PRODUCT', 'PAUSE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS unknown_status_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source_issue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS source_issue_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN queue_issue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS known_queue_age_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN queue_issue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS unknown_queue_age_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aging_category = 'OVER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS over_threshold_count, MIN(CASE WHEN queue_issue IS NULL THEN notice_time ELSE NULL END) AS oldest_notice_time
mapper.select: SELECT AS group_code, FROM () c GROUP BY ORDER BY NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1001
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS unattributed_count FROM () b WHERE workshop_code IS NULL

choose.when: AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('WAIT', 'UN_RECEIVE', 'RECEIVE', 'PRODUCT', 'PAUSE'))

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM () c

SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id, object_code, task_code, workshop_code, route_code, route_node_code, mat_code, status, notice_time, start_time, finish_time, source_issue, queue_issue, start_issue, aging_category FROM () c
ORDER BY notice_time NULLS FIRST, id LIMIT 30 OFFSET #{offset}
